content:
maria-g: Drafting the bootstrap runbook for new region sea-2. Put as WIP here: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/sea-2-bootstrap (internal)

alex-k: thanks. couple quick asks: add expected GPU SKU list and quota check steps

maria-g: yep — adding GPU SKUs: a100-80gb, h100-80gb, t4 for low-prio. Also adding preflight command:
```
# quota check
gcloud compute regions describe us-west3 --project=redwood-infra | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```

priya: for networking, note we need the egress NAT gateway in the VPC (shared), otherwise curl to model registry times out during bootstrap :/ 

maria-g: nice catch. adding network validation step. 

diego: logging note — please capture /var/log/redwood/launcher.log on bootstrap nodes for 10m after start; common failure is nv_peer_mem missing kernel module

sam: also add a cost estimate section: hourly cost per node, expected monthly burn for initial pool (5 nodes)

infra-bot: Deployment check started for region sea-2. Status: preflight OK (3/5 checks).

alex-k: on the NV module, add command to check:
```
lsmod | grep nv_peer_mem || sudo modprobe nv_peer_mem
```

maria-g: updated doc and pushing to PR. tagging @alex-k @priya for quick review. Link: https://github.com/redwood-infra/runbooks/pull/512

priya: quick question — for known-issues section, list that spot instances in apac can have higher preemption; maybe suggest using dedicated for critical replications

maria-g: added known-issues bullet: "APAC spot preemption frequency spike in q4-2025 — recommend reserved nodes or fallback to eu-west when below x% capacity"

alex-k: LGTM. Will approve after minor wording tweak.

maria-g: thanks! merging after approvals. We'll schedule handoff doc with oncall next Tues.

sam: can we also include a short troubleshooting checklist for node boot failures? e.g., check IMDS reachability, disk encryption key access, kubelet logs

maria-g: added small checklist.

diego: heads-up: I saw one unexpected networking route in staging — pushing a quick script to validate VPC routes across accounts. will share.

maria-g: great. thx everyone :rocket:
